primary_scope: Hand2/CurrierB/Botanical/P only, ordinary continuation-line starts primary control. v73 folio allocation, training vocabularies, source flags and exact matching unchanged. Other strata/interior controls remain v73 exploratory results. Scope chosen after v73; retrospective revision, not new independent confirmation.
revision: Two unit definitions as two hypotheses. For each unit require positive effects and all four one-sided folio tests (H/F x first-removal excess and first-vs-final interaction). Intersection-union p=max(four p values), then Bonferroni2. H/F not independent replication; no independence assumption in this conjunction. Exact sign-flip over7folios. Minimum adjustedp=.015625; old family48 remains recorded.
qualification: 100 fixed-seed trials per regime using actual v73 matched-cell opener/control counts and folio clusters, but no manuscript success outcomes. Explicit planted-prefix/suffix finite lexicons. Shared folio nuisance±.06; base firsthit .12, finalhit .08; syntheticH/F coupled seeds. Effects+.20,+.40,+.70; negatives no effect,commonline-start enhancement,suffixonly,Honly. Known synthetic prefix mechanism, not independently labelled natural-language morphology.
gate: Each unit detects>=80/100 at+.40 and>=90/100 at+.70. At most5/100 trials with any unit flag in each negative regime. If any gate fails, no rescoring manuscript. All trials retained. Small-effect power reported without a passing requirement.
limits: Only simulated controls with known planted prefixes; lexical geometry simplified. Does not establish power against all manuscript nuisances. No raw-token pseudo-replication; folios remain test units. No tuning to a successful result.
